content.test_md_blob:
# Web: open a product from a listing and verify its buying information is shown

> Prove that opening a product from a listing reveals the product information a shopper needs to decide whether to buy.

## Step 1

At {{start_url}}, open a product listing and open any listed product from that page.

## Step 2 @verifies ac-13, ac-14, ac-15, ac-16

On the product detail page for the opened product, inspect the product summary and purchase section, then assert the product name, product price, availability, and a quantity field are shown.
content.objectives_blob:
objectives:
  - objective: At {{start_url}}, open a product listing and open any listed product from that page.
    step: 1
  - check:
      expected_mode: authored
      kind: presence
      operand: product price on the product detail page
      operator: exists
      review_required: false
      verified_against: ac-13
    objective: On the product detail page for the opened product, inspect the product summary and purchase section, then assert the product name, product price, availability, and a quantity field are shown.
    step: 2
    verifies:
      - ac-13
      - ac-14
      - ac-15
      - ac-16
scenario: Open a product from a listing and inspect its buying information
title: 'Web: open a product from a listing and verify its buying information is shown'
